connector.name: Onepassword
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for interacting with 1Password via the CLI to read and manage credentials.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package onepassword-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.pulsemcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
env.description: Service account token for authentication with 1Password CLI.

env.name: ENABLED_TOOLGROUPS
env.description: Comma-separated tool groups to enable (readonly, write).

env.name: SKIP_HEALTH_CHECKS
env.description: Skip credential validation on server startup.

env.name: DANGEROUSLY_SKIP_ELICITATIONS
env.description: Bypass all credential approval prompts (exposes all secrets).

env.name: OP_ELICITATION_READ
env.description: Prompt for approval before revealing credentials.

env.name: OP_ELICITATION_WRITE
env.description: Prompt for approval before creating or sharing items.

env.name: OP_WHITELISTED_ITEMS
env.description: Comma-separated item titles or IDs that bypass read elicitation.
